text: {"overall_winner": "A", "qualities": [{"evidence": "writing entirely in English throughout the essay rather than switching to Spanish", "quality": "English Language Retention", "description": "Measures the ability to sustain writing in English without resorting to a native language."}, {"evidence": "phrases like \"Opening your company to people would help them understand\" and \"Instead of wasting time looking all the colleges\"", "quality": "Syntactic Complexity", "description": "Captures the use of varied sentence structures and clause combinations to express logical relationships."}, {"evidence": "words such as \"narrow the options\", \"future\", and \"understand\"", "quality": "Vocabulary Range", "description": "Reflects the breadth and accuracy of word choice used to convey specific meaning."}, {"evidence": "clear paragraphing focused on different benefits of a company visit", "quality": "Textual Organization", "description": "Measures how effectively ideas are structured into paragraphs and developed logically across the passage."}]}
